subject: Gambling / betting odds tools (poker odds, sports odds, lottery odds, dice)
reason: Brand misfit per prior red-team audit; regulated-adjacent, weak AdSense fit, and none of the seven competitors build a demand base worth entering.
evidence: docs/red-team-audit.md section 20 (brand misfit); seed list rows under Sports
reopen_if: Owner reverses the brand-misfit decision, or a regional licence-based product is planned.

subject: Novelty/curiosity calculators (Maine Coon colour, pigeon velocity, vocal range, semitone, one-block-wonder, boiling egg, weighted blanket, somatotype, hand size, clavicle length, Klipper rotation distance)
reason: Confirmed still present in calculatequick.com (about 22 of its 89 pages are curiosities) and still absent from our catalog for the right reason: no utility, high content cost, no workflow fit.
reopen_if: Never, unless a specific audience segment is adopted deliberately.

subject: Love / birthday / generation / zodiac / bra size / shoe size novelties
reason: Carried forward unchanged from the prior audit.
reopen_if: Never.

subject: WACC, cost of equity, real-time stock feeds, weather-fed calculators
reason: Saturated by calculatorsoup/gigacalculator on the finance side and extremely high maintenance with no differentiation available to us.
evidence: raw/calculatorsoup.md (Financial 105 incl. 25 TVM variants); raw/gigacalculator.md (corporate finance 23)
reopen_if: We adopt a professional/CFO audience as a deliberate vertical.

subject: simple-interest-calculator-v2
reason: Two entries named 'Simple Interest Calculator' exist on two URLs. A '-v2' slug is not a user-facing intent and will read as duplicate content.
reopen_if: Never - this is a defect, not a strategy.

subject: tip-split-calculator
reason: Third tip page in the catalog, duplicate display name, and filed under Finance instead of Everyday Tools.
reopen_if: Never.

subject: mortgage-payment-calculator
reason: Same output as the richer custom mortgage tool. Two URLs for one intent split internal links and dilute the flagship.
reopen_if: Only if a materially different mortgage product (e.g. interest-only) is offered.

subject: compound-interest-future-value
decision: MERGE into /compound-interest-calculator as a result field
reason: Future value is an output of the compound tool, not a separate job.
reopen_if: A standalone future-value-of-annuity tool is built (different inputs).

subject: emergency-fund-target-calculator
reason: Identical intent and near-identical inputs.
reopen_if: Never.

subject: water-temperature-converter
reason: A water-specific temperature converter is a subset of the generic converter with no distinct formula.
reopen_if: A cooking/brewing water-temperature intent proves distinct demand.

subject: bedtime-calculator
reason: Both implement 90-minute sleep-cycle bedtime/wake logic. Two URLs, one intent.
reopen_if: Never.

subject: waist-circumference-calculator
reason: Third waist measurement page; waist-to-height already provides the same risk classification with a better-evidenced metric.
reopen_if: Clinically-sourced waist-only guidance is published.

subject: 31 single-pair converters (kg-lb
reason: mph-kph
reopen_if: etc.)
column9: KEEP but make each page non-thin
column10: The prior audit called single-pair converters 'thin pages'. Evidence contradicts applying that blanket rule: thecalculatorsite publishes about 40 such pages and they match exact navigational queries (kg to lbs), which is how users actually search. Keep high-demand pairs; retire exotic ones; every retained pair page must carry a conversion table, a worked example and a reverse link.
column12: A pair page shows zero impressions for two consecutive quarters after launch.

subject: 113 tools with no reviewed seo block
reason: Only 57 of 170 tools carry reviewStatus=reviewed, yet all 170 are indexable and in the sitemap because a missing seo block defaults to indexable. Expanding the catalog while 113 pages are unreviewed multiplies the indexation risk the brief warns about.
reopen_if: All 170 reviewed - then this decision is closed.

subject: 'Free / best / 2026' keyword variants
reason: Keyword-swapped pages are explicitly rejected by the brief and the prior audit. Use the phrases in titles and FAQs on the canonical tool page instead.
reopen_if: Never.

subject: 'how much house can I afford' as a separate page from mortgage-affordability-account
reason: Same inputs, same output. The long-tail question is the H1 and FAQ of the affordability tool, not a second URL.
evidence: intent-cluster merge tests in methodology.md section 5
reopen_if: Never.

subject: IP subnet / CIDR developer cluster
reason: Prior roadmap wants a Developer Toolbox; prior red-team audit calls subnet 'competitor-dominated without differentiation'. Seven-competitor evidence shows fragmented coverage rather than saturation, so the gap is real but the differentiation case must be written first.
evidence: raw/calculatequick.md (5 dev tools); raw/calculator-net.md; docs/red-team-audit.md section 20
reopen_if: A differentiated dev-tool suite is specified (multi-tool workflow + copy-ready output).

subject: Real-money payout / investment-advice tools (which fund to buy, should I sell)
reason: Financial-advice exposure with no calculation core. The site computes, it does not advise.
reopen_if: Never.

subject: carb-intake-calculator + fat-intake-calculator + maintain-weight-calculator
reason: Single-nutrient and single-outcome pages duplicate the macro and TDEE tools' output and starve each other of links.
reopen_if: Each proves distinct query intent after launch.

subject: investment-roi-calculator
reason: Overlaps both roi-calculator and cagr-calculator. Keep only if it becomes the annualised holding-period return tool with distinct inputs.
reopen_if: A distinct output (annualised, dividend-inclusive) is specified.
